installCommand: cd frontend && env $(env | cut -d= -f1 | grep -iE "^npm_config_cache[-_]dir$" | sed "s/^/-u /") npm ci
buildCommand: cd frontend && env $(env | cut -d= -f1 | grep -iE "^npm_config_cache[-_]dir$" | sed "s/^/-u /") npm run build:static
